coordinateAndSeatContract.source: Right-handed Z-up model, canonical table center (87,87,0), dimensions174x174 source units. Size.TILE=(6,9,4), STICK=(20,2,1), MARKER=(12,6,1).
coordinateAndSeatContract.unityUnits: 0.01 Unity units per source unit. Classic layout position=(0.01*(x-87),0.01*z,0.01*(y-87)).
coordinateAndSeatContract.quaternion: For that Y/Z swap basis, qUnity=(-qx,-qz,-qy,qw), normalized; sizes swap Y/Z and scale0.01. Apply seat rotation exactly once.
coordinateAndSeatContract.seats: Canonical seats0 bottom,1 right,2 top,3 left. Source seat rotation is +90*seat degrees about Z; in the chosen Unity basis it is -90*seat yaw. Relative visual side=(seat-(viewSeat??0)+4)%4; actorSeat is independent.
coordinateAndSeatContract.rotationPolicy: Use ApplyLayout.slot.poses as the authority for quaternion/rotation arrays, not hardcoded Unity Euler guesses. Frames may carry a held override pose.
coordinateAndSeatContract.rectangular: Reposition slot groups using seat/local indexes to a fitted width/depth rectangle, without stretching tile meshes or changing source slot addresses/order/tiers. Supply colliders for the same slots in both layouts. Insets/hand band reduce the available board viewport.
coordinateAndSeatContract.separateHand: One Unity canvas with a separate orthographic local-hand camera/root band; remove those same entities from table-camera layer to avoid duplicates. Entities retain canonical slotName and entityId for actions. Remote hands stay around the board and concealed.
coordinateAndSeatContract.relayExtras: Render/select/move STICK and MARKER, Kita, tray/payment/riichi, hand.extra, discard.extra and Minefield wall.open slots too; tile-only rendering is incomplete.

slotGrammar.geometrySource: Use the actual Setup slot catalog, not this grammar as a replacement layout/rule generator.

privacyRules: No hidden numeric IDs or sentinel faces may be serialized to Unity. Opaque/back entities have faceIndex:null, knownFace:false, showFace:false. face:null is never defaulted to face0.
Use existing parseRealTileId/partitionThingEntries/resolveTileFace; numeric-string keys are entitled by value, not blindly opaque by typeof. Treat opaque keys as uninterpreted.
Keep only current viewer-projected identities; full snapshots remove absent entities; tombstones remove prior entries; opaque-to-real reveal is replace/remove, not a guessed handle-to-tile mapping.
Before the first bound Changsha full snapshot and after authority loss, publish empty entity/hand frames and clear caches. Never export the locally pre-baked 108 numeric placeholder tiles.
Changing a spectator camera/hand-layout/view mode must not trigger a new privileged snapshot, mutate actorSeat or infer concealed identities.

Do not claim the older Relay trust model has server-secret concealed IDs: retain its existing server filtering semantics and redact Unity presentation, but do not silently redesign that backend in this renderer task.
publicationRules: ApplyLayout and RendererFrame are complete snapshots. Layout changes only when Setup slot catalog/variant changes; full frame arrays replace all old live entities.
sessionId is a new adapter epoch on joining, disconnect/room switch, authority-seat change or protocol failure. Clear binds the new epoch. Old callbacks/actions/queued frames cannot cross it.
frameId increases monotonically within a session; layoutRevision increases on slot-catalog rebuild. Never mistake these adapter counters for backend versions.
Reject mismatched version/instance/session/layout and <=last frameId; emit a renderer error and fail closed. Do not try to guess unsupported enum values.
Coalesce visual frame publications to newest complete state at <=30Hz; input and primary network processing are not throttled or dropped. Unity owns visual interpolation.
No frame is published during partially applied Collection updates. Publishing from the headless sink should happen after the coherent model update.

All display-only source fields absent from an older relay payload are normalized by retained source compatibility readers; do not remove mandatory core conditions or pretend malformed snapshots are a ready game. Unexpected required-data ambiguity goes back to Lead rather than introducing new server fields.

An entityId is the primary render key, not slotName. Preserve baseline entries even if a pre-existing translator overflow uses duplicate slot addresses; surface the existing limitation rather than invent server slots.

Resolve only current selectable entities and pass internal source indexes to World.onHover/onSelect. Changsha cannot select foreign concealed/public runtime objects.

Relay/offline only. Frontend owns gestureId and anchor mapping; begin uses canonical source place and World.onMove/onSelect/onHover/onDragStart. slot-target wrapper translates selected target Slot.place into canonical displacement through existing World/Movement/findShift/canDrop rules. End calls World.onDragEnd or cancels in place. No Unity screen/world float is sent as a server action.
inputMapping.requirement: Add only a narrow safe source-slot wrapper if necessary; do not reimplement Shift, pushes, stacked walls or arbitrary wire mutation in Unity.

inputMapping.implementation: Relay/offline only. Resolve current selection, preserve source canFlipMultiple rule, call World.onSelect and World.onFlip(direction,animated).
Not RendererAction kinds in v1. Retain actual browser RuleActionControls and hand-result controller, with their advertised runtime gameId/stateVersion/resultToken checks.
Browser DOM preferences/controls remain authoritative for presentation and shell actions. Their changes republish frames/viewport, not new server fields.

actionValidation: Action envelope cannot carry actor seat, tileId, raw UPDATE, arbitrary collection name or auth data; additional properties are rejected.

Validate current instanceId/sessionId, known contextFrameId<=current frameId and current entity eligibility. Do not require equal frameId for animation/layout-only changes, but never act on a stale entity/authority/phase.
Subsequent drag messages require an active matching gestureId owned by the same actor/session. Cancellation, resize/orientation, disconnect or authority change ends it safely.
No mutation queue while offline/reconnecting/unbound; submitted only means sent to existing browser action pipeline. Server updates/rejection determine actual outcome.
lifecycle: Browser keeps lobby/shell usable before Unity load; table route fetches /autotable/unity/renderer-build.json and verifies supported version/relative same-origin paths.

Load the actual manifest-listed Unity loader script and call createUnityInstance(canvas,config,onProgress). Missing artifact/HTTP error is a visible Unity-build-unavailable state, not a legacy/canvas fallback.
Install window.MahjongUnityBridge.emit before load. After createUnityInstance resolves, SendMessage('MahjongBridge','Configure',configureJson); wait for matching C# Ready.
Send Clear(new session epoch), latest measured Viewport, complete RendererLayout, then newest coherent RendererFrame. Queue only the newest frame until ready.
C# emits FrameRendered only after its cameras have rendered the accepted frame (e.g. WaitForEndOfFrame), never merely after parsing JSON.
Only that callback may set unity-renderer-ready/scene-shell-ready. game-shell-ready may remain an earlier DOM-only feedback marker.
ResizeObserver, visualViewport/window resize and orientation changes recompute the actual canvas CSS rect, safe areas and backing buffer. Cancel active gestures before changed picking transforms.
widthPx=round(widthCssPx*renderPixelRatio), heightPx likewise, renderPixelRatio=min(devicePixelRatio,2); Send SetViewport before the next frame. If separate hand is disabled, handBandCssPx=0.
Use Unity-native pointer/touch raycasts with camera-specific viewports; host canvas touch-action prevents page pan only over the canvas, while DOM chat/lobby scroll and inputs retain normal behavior.
On visibility loss suspend visual work, not the primary WS. Resume sends latest viewport/layout/frame, not old animations.
On clear/disconnect revoke interactive flags and blank private hand immediately; on dispose remove listeners, discard queue and await unityInstance.Quit.
